inputSummary: Single-validator genesis, three local test-keyring accounts, and guarded local node lifecycle.

evidence.tddRed: Lifecycle contract failed because the start target was absent.
evidence.chain: babysteps-local-1 produced a positive block height.
evidence.genesis: One bonded validator with 500000000ubaby; exact three-account liquid balances passed.
evidence.network: API, RPC, and P2P were loopback-only and all ports released after stop.
evidence.security: No mnemonic or private key output; symlink, ownership, PID, and lock safety tests passed.

interventions: Replaced Ignite serve with direct generated daemon lifecycle after verified linked-worktree reference failure.
Removed two obsolete dangling lock links created by a rejected lock implementation from ignored runtime state.
